title: General.
officialText: Water heaters shall be tested in accordance with ANSI Z 21.10.1 and ANSI Z 21.10.3 and shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer’s installation instructions. Water heaters utilizing fuels other than fuel gas shall be regulated by the New York City Mechanical Code. Approval for water heaters 350,000 Btu/h input (1025 kW) and above shall be obtained from the New York City Department of Environmental Protection.
